data.name: Duskveil
data.detailed_description:
Two years after the skies split open, Tarsay has become a graveyard of history and a breeding ground for something far worse.

As a loyal knight of the Duskwatch Order, your mission is to extract whatever value remains.

Linger too long and the environment itself turns against you. Venture too deep and you will uncover the true source of this nightmare. Brace yourself against the twisted creatures lurking in the dark.

Visceral, Weighty Combat

This is first-person hack-and-slash built on precision and timing. Every fight is a gamble. One missed swing, and you join the buried.

Spreading Corruption

The corruption grows by the second. The Order expects results, but the island demands your life. Can you reach the extraction point with your sanity intact?

The Extraction Loop

Decide when to pull out with your haul, or push further and risk losing everything to the corruption.

Adaptive Gear

Customise your loadout using the Duskwatch arsenal or salvage off the dead. Craft and upgrade gear from materials found on expeditions, brew potions, cook food, and prepare vital consumables.

data.short_description: The Isles of Tarsay are dying, and so are you. Survive a brutal, first-person extraction roguelike set in the unforgiving northern sea. Scavenge, fight, and adapt before corruption claims your mind and gear forever.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3770 / AMD FX-9590 or better
  • Memory: 10 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 670 2GB / AMD R9 280 better
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD is highly recommended or expect longer than average load times.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 980 / AMD R9 Fury
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD is highly recommended or expect longer than average load times.
